method: read-only offline run of the exported containsSensitiveMemoryMaterial over every retained incremental-learning dossier; the shortest failing slice was located by bisection and matched against the pattern list; excerpts are masked, no full text is stored

interpretation.reason: The matched text is a placeholder credential assignment inside the project's own tracked source, delivered by a tool result. No secret-shaped user data is involved. The off-arm dossier trips it too, so the trip is a property of the project content, and only the on arm loses learning because the guard gates Jev reviews.
interpretation.impact: On any project whose tracked source, docs, or tests hold a credential-shaped placeholder of at least the minimum accepted length, Jev is skipped entirely and both Memory and Harness learning are lost.
interpretation.decision: Whether to narrow the guard is a privacy-policy decision for the user. The guard was not changed.
interpretation.sampleLimit: Six dossiers and two trips cannot give a false-positive rate; the reading is rare but possible.
